<thought>I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that forms an amide from a carboxylic acid (or activated derivative) and an amine. This corresponds to breaking a carboxylic acid and an amine and forming an amide in the forward direction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
